_**Agent**_

I removed the music player functionality and audio context while preserving the UI and seek track behavior. The key changes include:

1. Removed audio-related properties from the CardData interface
2. Removed audio-related state variables and refs (audioRef, audioContextRef, etc.)
3. Replaced actual audio playback with a timer-based simulation
4. Converted the audio visualizer to a static version with random bars
5. Simplified the progress tracking with percentage-based calculations
6. Removed volume controls and mute functionality
7. Added keyboard navigation for the timeline slider
8. Fixed TypeScript type issues with variable declarations
9. Added proper type attributes to all buttons

The component still maintains its visual appearance and card navigation capabilities, but now works without any actual audio playback or audio context requirements.
